issues.title: Should not shows 'Filter' for properties which not shows on 'Properties' of item
issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
Should not shows 'Filter' for properties which not shows on 'Properties' of item

## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Play game with data wargame-l6nngxlk
2. Click on channel 'Core Mapping'
3. Filter with 'ID' 
4. Notice no properties ID on item, but it still gets result for filter 'ID'

![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/195a4959-dd5c-4f7a-9394-373bf984dbb0)

## ⚙️ Expected behavior
Filter should only show properties which shows on 'Properties' panel

## 🖥️ Screenshots


## 💻 System information
 - Browser : Chrome
 - Browser Version : Version 120.0.6099.111


## 📝 Additional context
